heading: Application to Court
title: Application to Court
text: 290. Application to Court.__ (1) If any member or members holding not less than twenty per cent of the issued share capital of a company, or a creditor or creditors having interest equivalent in amount to not less than twenty per cent of the paid up capital of the company, complains, or complain, or the Commission or Registrar is of the opinion, that the affairs of the company are being conducted, or are likely to be conducted, in an unlawful or fraudulent manner, or in a manner not provided for in its memorandum, or in a manner oppressive to the members or any of the members or the creditors or any of them, or are being conducted in a manner prejudicial to the public interest; such member or members or creditor or creditors or, as the case may be, the Commission or Registrar, may make an application to the Court for an order under this section.

heading: Interim order
title: Interim order
text: 292. Interim order.__ Pending the making by it of a final order under section 290 the Court may, on the application of any party to the proceedings, make such interim order as it thinks fit for regulating the conduct of the company's affairs, upon such terms and conditions as appear to it to be just and equitable.
